text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone seemed to really enjoy the 
"Love's♡Cooking Extra Edition" the other 
day! Thanks to both of you, it created 
quite a buzz~♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, let's see? Oh—...wow. The view 
count is still shooting up! It's like the 
final three furlongs of a mile race!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Umm... The comments are saying... "Can't 
keep up with the punchlines, but looks 
delicious" "Classic flavor, but the edgy 
name is growing on me"—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Looking at this, it seems 
Gran-chan's naming sense has won out... 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"High-Protein Salad for 1.125 Miles" 
"Cheese Kamaboko Pasta: 1.25-Mile Style" 
"Seafood Rice Bowl ~Garnished with Dreams 
of 1.5 Miles~"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It seems... our passion for our dreams has 
reached the viewers as well. There are... 
so many warm comments.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
In other words, my passion for 
mile-conquering gourmet food got through 
to everyone! That's what this means, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was also able to take wonderful photos 
of you having fun while cooking; it was a 
lovely project.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Bringing out the true "Gran-chan" front 
and center is the classic, best approach 
for streaming, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? Maybe I'll try coming up with a 
two-mile menu next time, then!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right. Since we're here, why don't we aim 
to conquer every single distance menu?♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Let's do this! It's time for 
Extra Edition #2!
